summary: This is a clipped MoveIt documentation page, titled "movegroupinterfacetu", whose extracted text is almost entirely site navigation. It lists the MoveIt tutorial index across MoveIt 2 (Humble, Rolling) and MoveIt 1 (Noetic, Melodic), with the Move Group C++ Interface section and its subsections (Setup, Visualization, Planning to a Pose goal, Cartesian Paths, Adding objects, Attaching objects) as the page's focus. The note contains no tutorial body text, so specific technical details, code, or outputs are not available.
one_line: Navigation index of MoveIt robot-motion-planning tutorials, centered on the Move Group C++ Interface section, across ROS 1 and ROS 2 versions.
key_facts: The page lists MoveIt versions Moveit 2 - Humble, Moveit 2 - Rolling, MoveIt 1 - Noetic, and MoveIt 1 - Melodic.
The Move Group C++ Interface tutorial section lists the subsections Getting Started, Running the Code, Expected Output, and The Entire Code.
The Move Group C++ Interface's code subsections include Setup, Visualization, Getting Basic Information, Start the demo, and Planning to a Pose goal.
Further Move Group C++ Interface subsections include Visualizing plans, Moving to a pose goal, Planning to a joint-space goal, and Planning with Path Constraints.
The Move Group C++ Interface tutorial also covers Enforce Planning in Joint Space, Cartesian Paths, Adding objects to the environment, and Attaching objects to the robot.
The Move Group C++ Interface tutorial ends with Detaching and Removing Objects, The Launch File, and A Note on Setting Tolerances.
The site's quickstart tutorial is titled MoveIt Quickstart in RViz and includes a step to interact with the Panda robot.
The Move Group Python Interface tutorial is a separate page that includes Planning to a Joint Goal and Cartesian Paths sections.
Other listed tutorials include Planning Scene, Planning Scene Monitor, Motion Planning API, Motion Planning Pipeline, and Creating MoveIt Plugins.
Other listed tutorials include MoveIt Grasps, MoveIt Task Constructor, MoveIt Deep Grasps, and MoveItCpp Tutorial.
The MoveIt Setup Assistant tutorial has 12 numbered steps, from Step 1: Start through Step 12: Generate Configuration Files.
The URDF and SRDF tutorial covers Virtual Joints, Passive Joints, Groups, End-Effectors, Self-Collisions, and Robot Poses.
The Mesh Filter tutorial is titled Mesh Filter with UR5 and Kinect.
The Bullet collision checker tutorial is titled Using Bullet for Collision Checking and includes Continuous Collision Detection.
The note body contains no explanatory text beyond the navigation and section headings.
